checks.series_accuracy_note: In the same 2022 factsheet series, the MUM02 (Airoli) coordinate lies about 262 m from the MIDC plot that carries the Airoli facility's published plot number, so these printed coordinates are not survey-grade and may be off by a few hundred metres.
checks.imagery_visual_check: Esri World Imagery exports (visual check only, not a locator source): at the factsheet point a mid-size flat-roofed building with rooftop plant in a block of institutional and commercial plots south-west of the Noida-Greater Noida Expressway, facing a large complex across the road; at the page JSON-LD point open farmland beside a road and a drainage channel, with no building. Imagery dates not stated.
